summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` on the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array rotator function, shuffled hex-named identifiers, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are unrelated to a step-templates SDK. Because the payload runs under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime rather than under Node, Node-based static and runtime scanners on the installer's host do not inspect it. Fetching Bun from its GitHub releases page is legitimate in isolation, but here it is used only as a vehicle to execute obfuscated bundled code at `npm install` time, on any machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
